title: 2hr City Highlights Private Tour in Victoria BC
includes: Opportunities to customize tour along the way
Many photo opportunities during the tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Child booster seats are available upon request.
If you require an infant seat please contact us.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our private tour is a whirlwind adventure that captures the city's essence in a heartbeat! 

Embark on a exciting journey of Victoria's highlights when you only have a few hours to do it. 

With options of private tours for up to 4 people, up to 6 people or our private luxury bus seats 19 passengers! Wheelchair accessible options too! 

This tour offers private luxury transportation and engaging commentary from your guide. At each stop, you'll have the chance to step out and capture your memories with photographs.

Let us whisk you away with ten of Victoria must-see locations. Our tour is the gateway to unforgettable memories. 

The area exudes a charming and old-world atmosphere and despite some of the areas liveliness, there are moments of tranquility and peace amongst the regions rich history and culture. If you want some extra time in one location or want to drop another, the choice is yours. 

Your tour, your way!

Let us take you on a journey you will never forget!
